      {

      {
        "name": "Hayunn Naratha",
        "type": "npc",
        "text": "Hi again, how can I #help you this time?",

      },
      {
        "name": "qaplayera",

      },
      {
        "name": "Hayunn Naratha",
        "type": "npc",
        "text": "My mouth is dry, but I can't be seen to abandon this teaching room! Could you bring me some #beer from the #tavern?",

      },
      {
        "name": "Hayunn Naratha",
        "type": "npc",
        "text": "Oh, well forget it then. I guess I'll just hope for it to start raining, and then stand with my mouth open.",

      }
